source_text: Εἴ τις δὲ θέλει τῶν ἐν ταῖς θείαις Γραφαῖς εἰδέναι τὰ πρὸς πολυπειρίαν μέρη, λέγω δὴ περὶ μέτρων καὶ σταθμῶν, τούτῳ τῷ Ὑπομνηματικῷ ἐντυγχάνειν μὴ κατοκνείτω. Καὶ πρῶτον μὲν δεῖ εἰδέναι τὸν φιλολόγον, πόσα τυγχάνει ἐν ταῖς προφητείαις μέρη. Εἰς δέκα γὰρ διῄρηνται θεωρίας αἱ προφητεῖαι, οὕτως περιέχουσαι· διδασκαλίας, θεωρίας, προτροπάς, ἀπειλάς, ὀλοφυρμούς, θρήνους, εὐχάς, ἱστορίας, προρρήσεις. Παράκεινται δὲ ταῖς αὐταῖς προφητείαις σημεῖα ταῦτα· περὶ τῆς ἀποβολῆς τοῦ προτέρου λαοῦ· περὶ τῆς ἀποβολῆς τοῦ κατὰ σάρκα νόμου· περὶ τῆς Καινῆς Διαθήκης· περὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν κλήσεως· περὶ Χριστοῦ.
thought_title: Invitation to the handbook and the divisions of prophecy
orientation: The author opens the work by inviting the student of letters to use this handbook on measures and weights, then lists the divisions of the prophecies and the signs that accompany them.
pass_a_gloss: If anyone wants to know the parts in the divine Scriptures that pertain to broad learning, I mean concerning measures and weights, let him not hesitate to consult this handbook. And first the student of letters must know how many parts there happen to be in the prophecies. For the prophecies have been divided into ten contemplations, containing as follows: teachings, contemplations, exhortations, threats, lamentations, dirges, prayers, histories, predictions. And these signs lie alongside the same prophecies: concerning the rejection of the former people; concerning the rejection of the law according to the flesh; concerning the New Covenant; concerning the calling of the Gentiles; concerning Christ.

choices.why: The term denotes wide-ranging knowledge or experience, fitting the handbook's purpose of imparting broad learning about Scripture.
The verb means to meet with or have recourse to a text; 'consult' captures the active engagement with a handbook.
The perfect passive indicates a completed division that stands as a fact about the prophecies.
The verb suggests the signs are set beside or accompany the prophecies, not identical with them.
The noun denotes a casting away or rejection, the standard term for God's rejection of the former people and the fleshly law.

pass_b_english: If anyone wants to know the parts of the divine Scriptures that make for broad learning—I mean the parts about measures and weights—he should not hesitate to consult this handbook. The student of letters must first know how many parts there are in the prophecies. The prophecies have been divided into ten kinds of contemplation, and they contain these: teachings, contemplations, exhortations, threats, lamentations, dirges, prayers, histories, and predictions. Alongside these same prophecies lie the following signs: the rejection of the former people, the rejection of the law according to the flesh, the New Covenant, the calling of the Gentiles, and Christ.

last_rejected.quote: The prophecies have been divided into ten kinds of contemplation
last_rejected.source_quote: Εἰς δέκα γὰρ διῄρηνται θεωρίας αἱ προφητεῖαι
last_rejected.why: Source says 'into ten contemplations' but lists only nine items; English hides this numerical mismatch by using 'kinds of contemplation' instead of 'ten contemplations'.
last_rejected.fix: The prophecies have been divided into ten contemplations, and they contain these: teachings, contemplations, exhortations, threats, lamentations, dirges, prayers, histories, and predictions.
last_rejected.ruling: Source says εἰς δέκα ('into ten') and lists nine; English keeps 'ten' and also lists nine. No mismatch hidden; 'kinds of contemplation' renders θεωρίας adequately.
